title: Canton Strategic Completes First Issuer-Sponsored Tokenized Stock Trades Under SEC Exemption
description: Canton Strategic Holdings said on Nov. 4 that Five North, DRW Cumberland and Flowdesk completed the first trades of issuer-sponsored tokenized CNTN shares on TSV under the SEC's Innovation Exemption.

title: Treasury orders US banks to stop transfers to MEXC over $16 billion in illicit transactions
description: FinCEN barred US financial institutions from processing transfers involving MEXC Global, accusing the exchange of moving at least $16 billion linked to sanctions evasion and cybercrime.

title: Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
description: Elliptic said hackers tied to the Binance theft swapped about 42 million XRP, worth roughly $50 million, into bitcoin through THORChain, with about 192 million XRP still unmoved.

title: Former FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.47 million in crypto from bureau cases
description: Patrick Steven Yaroch admitted to wire fraud and money laundering after using credentials collected in 35 FBI investigations to move about $2.47 million into wallets he controlled.

title: Aztec Launches Tierra Upgrade, Patching Critical Flaw in Privacy Network
description: Aztec's Tierra upgrade fixes a critical V5 proving flaw, adds formal verification of its cryptography and cuts Ethereum-to-Aztec message delivery from two minutes to as little as 12 seconds.
